description:
In a multinational company's annual audit process, the audit coordinator initiates the audit process by sending a notification to the regional office.
The regional office prepares financial statements and gathers necessary documents.
Concurrently, the compliance team checks for any regulatory updates that might affect the audit.
Afterward, the regional office submits the documents to the central audit team.
The central audit team reviews the submission.
If discrepancies are found, they request clarifications from the regional office.
The regional office provides the necessary clarifications.
Once all documents are reviewed without issues, the audit team conducts a risk assessment.
The risk assessment includes evaluating financial risks, operational risks, and compliance risks, which can be done in any order but must all be completed.
If high risk is identified, then a detailed investigation is launched.
The investigation includes data analysis, interviews, and, in certain cases, site visits.
After all risks are addressed, the audit team compiles the audit report.
The report is reviewed by the audit director.
The audit director may approve the report or send it back for revisions.
If revisions are required, the audit team updates the report accordingly and resubmits it to be reviewed again by the audit director.
Once approved, the final report is distributed to the executive board and archived.
The entire audit process is then closed.

      </bpmn:lane>

      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditTeam" name="Central audit team">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewSubmission</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Discrepancies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestClarification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveClarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RiskJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HighRisk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AnalyzeData</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductSiteVisits</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SiteVisitMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InvestigationMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompileReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ArchiveReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AuditClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AuditDirector" name="Audit director">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReportDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Audit" name="Annual audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to regional office" messageRef="Message_AuditNotification"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Run preparation and compliance check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSubmission" name="Receive document submission" messageRef="Message_DocumentSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Preparation and compliance check complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewSubmission" name="Review submission"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Discrepancies" name="Discrepancies found?" default="Flow_NoDiscrepancies"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestClarification" name="Request clarifications" messageRef="Message_ClarificationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveClarifications" name="Receive clarifications" messageRef="Message_ClarificationResponse"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskSplit" name="Assess all risk areas"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" name="Evaluate financial risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" name="Evaluate operational risks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" name="Evaluate compliance risks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RiskJoin" name="All risk areas assessed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HighRisk" name="High risk identified?" default="Flow_NoHighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeData" name="Analyze data"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterviews" name="Conduct interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired" name="Site visit required?" default="Flow_NoSiteVisit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Continue investigation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" name="Risks addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportDecision" name="Approve report?" default="Flow_ReportRevisions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateReport" name="Update report"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DistributeReport" name="Distribute final report" messageRef="Message_FinalReport"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArchiveReport" name="Archive final report"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AuditClosed" name="Audit process closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AuditStartToNotification" sourceRef="Start_Audit" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToSplit" sourceRef="Task_SendNotification" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSubmission" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSubmission"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">discrepanciesFound = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" name="No discrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Gateway_RiskSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToResponse" sourceRef="Task_RequestClarification" targetRef="Task_ReceiveClarifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResponseToReview" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveClarifications" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToFinancial" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToOperational" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplitToCompliance" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinancialToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OperationalToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplianceToRiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskJoinToHighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HighRiskToInvestigation" name="High risk identified" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeData">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" name="No high risk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewsToSiteDecision" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">siteVisitRequired = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" name="No site visit required" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitRequired" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitMergeToInvestigationMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvestigationMergeToCompile" sourceRef="Gateway_InvestigationMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompileToDirectorReview" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DirectorReviewToDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReviewReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportApproved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportRevisions" name="Revisions required" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportDecision" targetRef="Task_UpdateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateToReview" sourceRef="Task_UpdateReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DistributeToArchive" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArchiveToClosed" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RegionalOffice">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RegionalOffice" name="Regional office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RegionalNotification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFinancialStatements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_DocumentsSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Clarifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RegionalNotification" name="Audit notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RegionalNotification" messageRef="Message_AuditNotification"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" name="Prepare financial statements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherDocuments" name="Gather necessary documents"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitDocuments" name="Submit documents" messageRef="Message_DocumentSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DocumentsSubmitted" name="Documents submitted"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Clarifications" name="Respond to clarification request" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ClarificationRequest" name="Clarification request received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ClarificationRequest" messageRef="Message_ClarificationRequest"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideClarifications" name="Provide necessary clarifications"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendClarifications" name="Send clarifications" messageRef="Message_ClarificationResponse"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarificationStartToProvide" sourceRef="Start_ClarificationRequest" targetRef="Task_ProvideClarifications"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideToSendClarifications" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Task_SendClarifications"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendClarificationsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendClarifications" targetRef="End_ClarificationsSent"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegionalStartToStatements" sourceRef="Start_RegionalNotification" targetRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatementsToDocuments" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFinancialStatements" targetRef="Task_GatherDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsToSubmission" sourceRef="Task_GatherDocuments" targetRef="Task_SubmitDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmissionToRegionalEnd" sourceRef="Task_SubmitDocuments" targetRef="End_DocumentsSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
